title: Gaudi terrace and apartment architecture
text: We enjoyed the late night tour. The guide was really nice. We walked through the apartment and saw the different rooms. Went to the terrace for a slide view. You could see the whole city. It was a lovely experience. All the lights of the city and the Sagrada far away. It was great to see old artefacts still in the apartment. The terrace had a unique structure that were chimneys. The attic was so cool and open.
author: archlav
